scope.statement: Authoritative Odisha institutional evidence contradicts treating Pankoddhar as a spelling-only alias of the ordinary Vijaya household lane. Sri Lokanath Temple's annual sanctum-water-removal and linga-darshan event is Shaiva, place-bound, live-schedule-dependent and institution-controlled. A future place/temple owner must verify current programme, access, crowd, offering, water, health and safeguarding conditions; ritual-calendar does not reproduce the institutional action at home.
